The '''Kuati Succession Crisis''' occurred in [[311 BBY]], after the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] company [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] principal [[Director/Legends|director]] [[Ursela Kuat]] [[Death/Legends|died]] when their [[Ursela Kuat's star yacht|star yacht]] was destroyed by the [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]] placed along the [[Rothana Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to restrict access to [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]], a KDY-run [[Factory world/Legends|factory planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] after the Kuati Succession Crisis, it was revealed Ursela Kuat was actually assassinated by their rivals on the KDY directorate.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kuati Succession Crisis was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
